newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain's Batelco cuts international rates.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain's Batelco cuts international rates.

text.p: Bahrain Telecommunications Co (Batelco) announced on Tuesday it would reduce charges of international telephone calls and private leased circuits from March 1.

Batelco officials said in a statement the reduction on international direct dialed (IDD) calls of up to 45 percent, would make Bahrain, the Gulf's main financial and banking centre, more competitive regionally.

"The new rates, which will bring down IDD call charges to over 170 destinations, will apply to all IDD calls made from all types of communication apparatus including fixed, facsimile, mobile and payphones," business manager Karim Maidan said.
Charges on international private leased circuits to the United states, Europe, Mediterranean, Asia and Africa would be cut by an average 20 percent, Batelco said.

Batelco, which has one of the most advanced networks in the region, is 39 percent owned by the Bahraini government and 20 percent by Cable and Wireless Plc of Britain. The rest is held by investors and financial institutions.
